summary.text: Pat Jehlen is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts Senate for the Second Middlesex District, which includes Cambridge, Medford, Somerville and part of Winchester, and has served in the Senate since 2005.
The Legislature's committee listing shows her as Chair of the Joint Committee on Aging and Independence and Vice Chair of the Joint Committees on Education and on Revenue.

paragraphs.text: The official biography page lists Jehlen's education as Newton High School, a B.A. from Swarthmore College and an M.A.T. from Harvard University.
It lists her public service as the school committee from 1976 to 1991, the Massachusetts House from 1991 to 2005, and the Senate from 2005 to the present.
